groups.title: 1. Bootstrap and Manager settings
groups.intro: Wait for the Manager API, read server info, then administration settings, cluster and users.

groups.title: 2. Controllers, edges and certificates
groups.intro: Add controllers, upload the WAN edge list, install certificates and read device inventory.

groups.title: 3. Software repository and upgrades
groups.intro: Upload images to the repository, then upgrade devices.

groups.title: 4. Classic templates
groups.intro: Feature templates, device templates, CLI templates, template recovery and device mode.

groups.title: 5. Configuration groups (UX 2.0)
groups.intro: Feature profiles, configuration groups and their deployment.

groups.title: 6. Monitoring and operations
groups.intro: Health checks, alarms and active sessions.

groups.title: 7. Other
groups.intro: Modules that fit none of the groups above. Nothing is guessed into another group.
